description: A mountaintop monastery above the clouds. Weapons are useless here: fight unarmed through the courtyard, the bell hall, the garden and the hall of statues to face the Grandmaster. Recommended level 22.

actions.text: The initiates bow out. The Bell Hall opens.
The statues fall dormant. The Sanctum waits.
The Grandmaster bows. His offering is revealed.
